why: Complete direct visual inspection of the native nature catalog in current-source normal-scale night and rain scenes across all three launch ground palettes.
sourceIdentity: All inputs and board pixels independently rehashed after inspection.
findings: All forty-two boards individually inspected; twenty catalog entries at minimum, unit and maximum sizes in each of three biomes, in night and rain (360 compositions).
No additional blocking clipping, scale mismatch, detached ground contact, opaque sprite ground island or inconsistent night brightness observed in these controlled static compositions.
Small grasses and low plants blend into finer Cerrado and Caatinga ground texture at minimum size, especially at night. Retain this as a readability concern for overview and mixed-landscape review.
limits: Static normal zoom only; no animation or physical-display pacing claim.
Every catalog entry compared against each ground palette does not mean every species is ecologically appropriate in each biome.

Normal daylight inspection, overview captures/inspection, close weather views, mixed habitats, neighboring nature clusters, transitions, custom resident world coverage and full original release gates remain open.
